001import java.lang.StringBuilder;
002import java.util.HashMap;
003import java.util.Set;
004
005/**
006 * Classe Room - un lieu du jeu d'aventure Zuul.
007 *
008 * @author votre nom
009 */
010public class Room
011{
012    private String aDescription;
013    private HashMap<String, Room> exits;
014    private String aImageName;
015    private HashMap<String,Item> aItems;
016    
017    /**
018     * Create a room
019     * pDescription = text deescribing the room
020     * 
021     * @param pDescription String describing the room
022     * @param pImage String containing path to image
023     */
024    public Room(final String pDescription, final String pImage)
025    {
026        this.aDescription = pDescription;
027        this.exits = new HashMap<String, Room>();
028        this.aImageName = pImage;
029        this.aItems = new HashMap<String, Item>();
030    }// Room(.)
031    
032    public String getDescription()
033    {
034        return this.aDescription;
035    }// getDescription()
036    
037    public String getLongDescription()
038    {
039        StringBuilder vLongDescription = new StringBuilder("You are : ");
040        vLongDescription.append(this.aDescription);
041        vLongDescription.append(".\n" + this.getExitString() );
042        vLongDescription.append(".\n" + this.getItemString() );
043        return vLongDescription.toString();
044    }// getLongDescription()
045
046    public String getItemsDescription()
047    {
048        if ( this.aItems.isEmpty() ) {
049            return "No item here.";
050        }
051        
052        StringBuilder vItems = new StringBuilder("Items : \n");
053        for (String vItem: this.aItems.keySet()) {
054            vItems.append( aItems.get(vItem).getLongDescription() + "\n" );
055        }
056        return vItems.toString();
057    }
058    
059    /**
060     * @param pNom item name
061     * @param pDescription item description
062     * @param pWeight int representing the item's weight
063     */
064    public void addItem(final String pNom, final String pDescription, final int pWeight)
065    {
066        this.aItems.put(pNom, new Item(pNom, pDescription, pWeight));
067    }
068    
069    /**
070     * Define an exit for the room.
071     */
072    public void setExit(final String pDirection, final Room pNeighbor)
073    {
074        this.exits.put(pDirection, pNeighbor);
075    }// setExit(..)
076    
077    public Room getExit(final String pDirection)
078    {
079        return this.exits.get(pDirection);
080    }// getExit(.)
081    
082    public String getExitString()
083    {
084        StringBuilder vExits = new StringBuilder("Exits : ");
085        for (String vDir: this.exits.keySet()) {
086            vExits.append(vDir + "  ");
087        }
088        return vExits.toString();
089    }// getExitString(.)
090    
091    public Item getItem(final String pItemName)
092    {
093        return this.aItems.get(pItemName);
094    }
095    
096    /**
097     * returns String containing list of Item objects in the current Room
098     * if there is no items : returns "No item here."
099     */
100    public String getItemString()
101    {
102        if ( this.aItems.isEmpty() ) {
103            return "No item here.";
104        }
105        
106        StringBuilder vItems = new StringBuilder("Items : ");
107        for (String vItem : this.aItems.keySet()) {
108            vItems.append(vItem + "  ");
109        }
110
111        return vItems.toString();
112    }// getExitString(.)
113    
114    /**
115     * accesseur aImageName
116     */
117    public String getImageName()
118    {
119        return this.aImageName;
120    }
121}// Room
